name: Drupal
description_en:
Drupal is an open-source PHP content framework for building structured websites and digital applications. Developers and site builders define content types, fields, roles and presentation; editors then maintain content through the resulting interface. The current website distinguishes the Drupal Core building blocks from Drupal CMS, a more preconfigured starting point for marketers and site builders.

Free GPL software does not eliminate hosting, implementation, migration or maintenance. Evaluate the exact installation profile and contributed modules rather than assuming every headline capability is enabled in a minimal Core site. APIs, multilingual workflows and visual page building need the corresponding configuration and an operating team.
description_zh:
Drupal 是开源PHP内容框架，用于构建结构化网站及数字应用。开发者和建站者定义内容类型、字段、角色及展示，编辑者再通过配置后的界面维护内容。当前官网区分作为构建基础的Drupal Core与面向营销/建站者、更预配置的Drupal CMS。

GPL软件免费，不免除托管、实施、迁移及维护成本。应评估实际安装配置和社区模块，不能假定每个宣传能力都在最小Core站启用；API、多语言工作流和可视化建页需要相应配置及运营团队。

sections.title_en: Choose between building blocks and a prepared starting point
sections.title_zh: 选择基础构建块或预配置起点
sections.en:
The official technical overview presents Drupal Core as a customizable framework built around Composer, Symfony, Twig and a modular architecture. The Drupal CMS page describes defaults, recipes, content types and marketer-facing tools built on that foundation. At this read it advertisesDrupal CMS2.0with Drupal Canvas visual page building and optional AI governance. Those are packaging/version-specific statements, not a feature guarantee for every Core installation or older Drupal site.

An organization with specialized data and integration needs can start from Core and select modules; a marketing site can evaluate the CMS starting package. Compare the actual content model, editing permissions, templates and upgrade path. The site’s setup-time, performance, privacy-compliance and accessibility claims were not independently tested and do not establish legal compliance for a customer installation.
sections.zh:
官方技术概览将Drupal Core描述为基于Composer、Symfony、Twig及模块架构的可定制框架；Drupal CMS页描述在其上组合默认设置、recipes、内容类型及营销工具。实读页面宣传Drupal CMS2.0、Drupal Canvas可视化建页及可选AI治理，属于特定包/版本陈述，不保证任意Core安装或旧站具有相同功能。

有特殊数据和集成需求的机构可从Core选择模块，营销站可评估CMS起始包。应比较实际内容模型、编辑权限、模板及升级路径。本次未独立测试官网的设置时长、性能、隐私合规或可访问性主张，也不据此认定客户安装符合法律要求。

sections.title_en: Create content with the actual profile and publication state
sections.title_zh: 按实际安装配置及发布状态创建内容
sections.en:
The user guide’s page-creation exercise requires the Basic page content type supplied by the Core Standard installation profile. It has the editor choose Content > Add content > Basic page, fill the title/summary/body, set an alias, preview and save. The Published field controls whether that example is public. The profile prerequisite matters: a custom content model may expose different fields or permissions.

For a real pilot, create an About page and a structured service entry, check previews, URL aliases and visibility with a separate public browser, then add the required navigation. Creating a content item does not itself prove its menu placement, homepage assignment or an editorial approval workflow. This is a documentation-based exercise; no page was created here.
sections.zh:
用户指南的建页练习要求存在Core Standard安装配置提供的Basic page内容类型：编辑者进入Content > Add content > Basic page，填写标题/摘要/正文、设置别名、预览并保存，Published字段控制该示例是否公开。这个前提很重要，定制内容模型可能提供不同字段及权限。

实际试点可建About页和结构化服务条目，以独立访客检查预览、URL别名和可见性，再添加所需导航。创建内容本身不能证明菜单位置、首页设置或编辑审批工作流已成立。上述为文档练习，本次未创建页面。

sections.title_en: Specify modules, languages and frontend responsibility
sections.title_zh: 明确模块、语言及前端责任
sections.en:
Drupal documents configurable multilingual workflows, role-based access, configuration management and API-first/headless delivery. These provide options for a multilingual organization or custom frontend, but do not automatically supply translation labor, tenant isolation or a complete external application. Specify the modules, languages, fields and endpoints being delivered, and test each editorial/public role.

The ecosystem has modules, themes and recipes with different purposes: modules extend behavior, themes affect presentation, and recipes automate selected setup/configuration. An integration listing is not an executed connection. Headless implementations must also handle preview, authentication, routing, cache invalidation and media on the frontend. Optional AI services require their own configuration, usage budget and review of generated content.
sections.zh:
Drupal文档描述可配置多语言工作流、角色访问、配置管理及API优先/无头交付，能为多语言机构或定制前端提供选项，但不会自动承担翻译工作、保证租户隔离或提供完整外部应用。应明确交付模块、语言、字段及终端，并测试编辑/访客各角色。

模块、主题和recipes作用不同：模块扩展行为，主题影响展示，recipes自动完成选定设置/配置。集成目录不等于连接已执行；无头实现还需前端处理预览、认证、路由、缓存失效及媒体。可选AI服务也需独立配置、使用预算和生成内容复核。

sections.title_en: Manage dependencies and recover the whole site
sections.title_zh: 管理依赖并恢复完整站点
sections.en:
The Composer guide uses drupal/recommended-project for a new Core project and separates acquiring a contributed package from updating it with dependencies. It identifies composer.json, composer.lock, vendor and autoloading among the files relevant to dependency management. Its sample historical version numbers are examples, not current runtime or release recommendations. The commands were not run.

Select supported Core/PHP/database/module versions and keep deployment artifacts consistent with the lockfile. Before an upgrade, test the actual editorial and API flows and restore a snapshot containing database, files and required configuration. A downloaded module is not proof it is configured, secure or compatible; a copied code tree alone does not restore content stored in the database. Hosting and dependency/security maintenance remain explicit operating responsibilities.
sections.zh:
Composer指南对新Core项目使用drupal/recommended-project，并区分取得社区包与连同依赖更新，指出composer.json、composer.lock、vendor及自动加载等依赖管理相关文件。其中历史版本号仅为示例，不是当前运行环境或版本推荐，本次未执行命令。

需选择受支持Core/PHP/数据库/模块版本，并使部署产物与锁文件一致。升级前测试实际编辑/API流程，恢复包含数据库、文件及必要配置的快照。下载模块不能证明已配置、安全或兼容，仅复制代码树也不能恢复数据库中的内容。托管和依赖/安全维护需明确责任。

sections.title_en: Separate GPL rights from service and asset costs
sections.title_zh: 区分GPL权利与服务及资产成本
sections.en:
The licensing FAQ identifiesDrupal and derivative contributions hosted onDrupal.orgasGPLv2or later. It allows commercial distribution and explains that operating a website does not by itself require giving its server code to every visitor. Distribution obligations and third-party assets/libraries still require attention. Non-code assets can have separate terms, and a remote proprietary service is not made free by a Drupal integration. These are source summaries, not legal advice.

The Drupal CMS page says the software remains free/open source. Domains, hosting, implementation, migration, paid services and ongoing operations are separate costs; no numeric total or support quote was established. Drupal suits teams prepared to own a structured, extensible platform or hire a partner. A small site needing fully handled operations should price that service explicitly rather than assuming the free download includes it.
sections.zh:
许可FAQ将Drupal及Drupal.org托管的衍生贡献标为GPLv2或后续版本，允许商业分发，并解释运营网站本身不要求向每位访客交付服务器代码。分发义务及第三方资产/库仍需关注，非代码资产可有独立条款，远程专有服务不会因Drupal集成而免费。这是来源概括，不是法律意见。

Drupal CMS页称软件保持免费开源；域名、主机、实施、迁移、付费服务及持续运营另计，本次未建立数字总成本或支持报价。愿意自主管理结构化可扩展平台或聘请伙伴的团队可考虑；需要全包运营的小站应明确服务价格，不能假定免费下载已包含。
